answer: We demonstrate that spectral partition barriers enforce exponential decay of adversarial weight via personalized EigenTrust attenuation, preventing the adversary from constructing a robust information reef that disrupts propagation. This spectral filtering isolates compromised nodes acting as a hostile wharf between the legitimate orchard and rogue clusters, ensuring that trust vectors converge solely within the honest subspace while eigenvalues associated with Sybil identities decay exponentially at the graph cut.
